name: Fattoush
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 head romaine lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces
¼ cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
1 green bell pepper, seeded and chopped
4 pita rounds, toasted and torn into pieces

steps: Mix the water and cornstarch in a small saucepan over medium-high heat until thickened.
Remove from heat, and mix in lemon juice, garlic, sumac, salt, and pepper.
In a large bowl, toss together the lettuce, cucumber, tomatoes, green onions, parsley, mint, bell pepper, purslane, and arugula.
Toss with the dressing, and serve with pita.

culture.text: Fattoush is a Levantine salad made from toasted or fried pieces of pita combined with mixed greens and other vegetables, such as radishes, cucumber and tomatoes. Fattoush is a common part of meals in communities in the Levant.
